---
title: "Explore South Florida"
---

Use the dropdown to focus on one county or compare all three. Hover over a point for its block group and estimates; drag across the chart to zoom, then use the plot controls to zoom in or out.

```{r}
#| label: load-acs-data
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

county_colors <- c(
  "Miami-Dade" = "#0072B2",
  "Broward" = "#E69F00",
  "Palm Beach" = "#009E73"
)

acs_data <- read_csv(
  "data/south-florida-block-groups.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(county = factor(county, levels = names(county_colors)))
```

## Interactive income and age

Each point is one of **`r format(nrow(acs_data), big.mark = ",")` block groups**. The estimates describe the block group as a whole; they are not measurements of individual residents.

```{r}
#| label: interactive-income-age
#| fig-height: 7

plot_ly(
  data = acs_data,
  x = ~median_household_income,
  y = ~median_age,
  split = ~county,
  color = ~county,
  colors = unname(county_colors),
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  text = ~block_group,
  customdata = ~county,
  hovertemplate = paste0(
    "Block group: %{text}<br>",
    "Median household income: $%{x:,.0f}<br>",
    "Median age: %{y:.1f} years<br>",
    "County: %{customdata}<extra></extra>"
  ),
  marker = list(size = 7, opacity = 0.65)
) |>
  layout(
    title = list(text = "Median income and age by block group"),
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Median household income (USD)",
      tickprefix = "$",
      separatethousands = TRUE
    ),
    yaxis = list(title = "Median age (years)"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "County"), orientation = "h"),
    updatemenus = list(
      list(
        type = "dropdown",
        active = 0,
        x = 0,
        y = 1.15,
        buttons = list(
          list(
            label = "All counties",
            method = "restyle",
            args = list(list(visible = c(TRUE, TRUE, TRUE)))
          ),
          list(
            label = "Miami-Dade",
            method = "restyle",
            args = list(list(visible = c(TRUE, FALSE, FALSE)))
          ),
          list(
            label = "Broward",
            method = "restyle",
            args = list(list(visible = c(FALSE, TRUE, FALSE)))
          ),
          list(
            label = "Palm Beach",
            method = "restyle",
            args = list(list(visible = c(FALSE, FALSE, TRUE)))
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
```

## Compare county distributions

These boxplots summarize the distribution of block-group median income and median age in each county. A higher box means higher estimates for a typical block group; wide boxes and whiskers show variation within a county.

```{r}
#| label: county-demographic-boxplots
#| fig-height: 7

acs_data |>
  select(county, median_household_income, median_age) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(median_household_income, median_age),
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    measure = recode(
      measure,
      median_household_income = "Median household income (USD)",
      median_age = "Median age (years)"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = county, y = estimate, fill = county)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.alpha = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(vars(measure), scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = county_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Block-group estimate",
    caption = "Each box summarizes block-group estimates, not individual residents."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

Data source: [U.S. Census Bureau American Community Survey](https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/acs/data.html), 2020–2024 five-year estimates.
